pasteReady._howToUse: Review each entry. Where the candidate is right, copy "column" into the matching metric in backend/src/kag/glossary.data.json and rebuild. Where it is wrong or absent, the metric has no backing data — fix upstream or remove the KPI from dataSourceMap.ts.

note: Metrics with no confirmed column mapping. Confirm a candidate by setting "column" for that metric in backend/src/kag/glossary.data.json, then rebuild. Candidates are name-similarity proposals only and are NOT in the graph.
